```{r}
#| label: build-candidate-ecology-figures
#| echo: true
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
})

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
data_root <- if (length(args) >= 1L) args[[1L]] else Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_DATA_ROOT")
out_root <- if (length(args) >= 2L) args[[2L]] else file.path(data_root, "derived", "manuscript_candidates")

if (!nzchar(data_root) || !dir.exists(data_root)) {
  stop("Provide the PRJEB79569 data root as the first argument or PHAGE_UV_DATA_ROOT.")
}

script_path <- Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_NOTEBOOK_PATH")
if (!nzchar(script_path)) {
  script_arg <- grep("^--file=", commandArgs(), value = TRUE)
  if (length(script_arg)) script_path <- sub("^--file=", "", script_arg[[1L]])
}
if (!nzchar(script_path)) {
  candidates <- c(
    file.path(getwd(), "scripts", "build_candidate_ecology_figures.qmd"),
    file.path(getwd(), "build_candidate_ecology_figures.qmd")
  )
  script_path <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)][[1L]]
}
script_path <- normalizePath(script_path)
repo_root <- dirname(dirname(script_path))
source(file.path(repo_root, "R", "figure_style.R"))

tables_dir <- file.path(out_root, "tables")
figures_dir <- file.path(out_root, "figures")
dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

save_candidate <- function(name, plot, width, height) {
  ggsave(
    file.path(figures_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")),
    plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in",
    device = grDevices::pdf,
    useDingbats = FALSE
  )
  ggsave(
    file.path(figures_dir, paste0(name, ".png")),
    plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in",
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )
}

taxonomy_path <- file.path(data_root, "annotation", "catbat", "gtdb", "BAT.bin2classification.txt")
taxonomy <- fread(taxonomy_path, check.names = FALSE)
setnames(taxonomy, "# bin", "MAG_ID")
taxonomy[, MAG_ID := sub("\\.fasta$", "", MAG_ID)]

rank_names <- c(
  d = "domain",
  p = "phylum",
  c = "class",
  o = "order",
  f = "family",
  g = "genus",
  s = "species"
)

extract_rank <- function(lineage, prefix) {
  vapply(strsplit(lineage, ";", fixed = TRUE), function(parts) {
    hit <- parts[startsWith(parts, paste0(prefix, "__"))]
    if (!length(hit)) return(NA_character_)
    value <- sub(paste0("^", prefix, "__"), "", hit[[1L]])
    value <- sub("\\*$", "", value)
    if (!nzchar(value)) NA_character_ else value
  }, character(1))
}

for (rank in names(rank_names)) {
  taxonomy[, (rank_names[[rank]]) := extract_rank(lineage, rank)]
}
taxonomy[is.na(phylum), phylum := "Unclassified"]
taxonomy[, phylum_display := fifelse(
  phylum %chin% names(phage_uv_phylum_colours),
  phylum,
  "Other"
)]

fwrite(
  taxonomy[, c("MAG_ID", unname(rank_names), "phylum_display"), with = FALSE],
  file.path(tables_dir, "mag_taxonomy_crosswalk.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

uv_summary <- fread(file.path(data_root, "community_uv_response", "uv_signature_mag_summary.tsv"))
host_links <- fread(file.path(data_root, "host_phage_linking", "full", "summary_data", "host_phage_links.tsv"))
host_edges <- unique(host_links[, .(MAG_ID, phage_id_or_vOTU_id)])
priority <- fread(file.path(
  data_root,
  "community_uv_response",
  "variant_analysis",
  "instrain",
  "priority_mag_inputs",
  "priority_mags.tsv"
))
instrain <- fread(file.path(
  data_root,
  "community_uv_response",
  "variant_analysis",
  "instrain_priority_20",
  "tables",
  "priority20_rmag_snv_divergence.tsv"
))

set_members <- rbindlist(list(
  data.table(set = "All classified MAGs", MAG_ID = taxonomy$MAG_ID),
  data.table(set = "UV-signature positive", MAG_ID = unique(uv_summary$MAG_ID)),
  data.table(set = "Host linked", MAG_ID = unique(host_edges$MAG_ID)),
  data.table(set = "Priority set", MAG_ID = unique(priority$MAG_ID)),
  data.table(set = "inStrain analyzable", MAG_ID = unique(instrain$MAG_ID))
))
set_members <- taxonomy[set_members, on = "MAG_ID"]
set_members[, set := factor(
  set,
  levels = c(
    "All classified MAGs",
    "UV-signature positive",
    "Host linked",
    "Priority set",
    "inStrain analyzable"
  )
)]

set_composition <- set_members[, .(n_mags = uniqueN(MAG_ID)), by = .(set, phylum_display)]
set_composition[, proportion := n_mags / sum(n_mags), by = set]
set_composition[, set_n := sum(n_mags), by = set]
fwrite(set_composition, file.path(tables_dir, "mag_set_phylum_composition.tsv"), sep = "\t")

tax_order <- set_composition[set == "All classified MAGs"][order(-n_mags)]$phylum_display
tax_order <- unique(c(tax_order, "Other"))
set_composition[, phylum_display := factor(phylum_display, levels = rev(tax_order))]

p_funnel <- ggplot(set_composition, aes(x = set, y = proportion, fill = phylum_display)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  geom_text(
    data = unique(set_composition[, .(set, set_n)]),
    aes(x = set, y = 1.025, label = paste0("n = ", set_n)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 2.6,
    vjust = 0
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = phage_uv_phylum_colours, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.09))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "MAGs", fill = "Phylum") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_phage_uv() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
save_candidate("mag-selection-taxonomic-context", p_funnel, 8.1, 4.8)

host_degree <- host_edges[, .(n_linked_votus = uniqueN(phage_id_or_vOTU_id)), by = MAG_ID]
host_degree <- taxonomy[host_degree, on = "MAG_ID"]
host_degree[, phylum_display := fifelse(
  phylum %chin% names(phage_uv_phylum_colours),
  phylum,
  "Other"
)]
host_degree <- host_degree[order(-n_linked_votus, MAG_ID)]
fwrite(host_degree, file.path(tables_dir, "deduplicated_host_degree.tsv"), sep = "\t")

host_top <- host_degree[seq_len(min(30L, .N))]
host_top[, label := fifelse(
  !is.na(genus) & genus != "",
  paste0(genus, " | ", MAG_ID),
  paste0(phylum, " | ", MAG_ID)
)]
host_top[, label := factor(label, levels = rev(label))]

p_host <- ggplot(host_top, aes(x = n_linked_votus, y = label, colour = phylum_display)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = n_linked_votus, yend = label), colour = "#D0D0D0", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = phage_uv_phylum_colours, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks()) +
  labs(x = "Unique linked vOTUs", y = NULL, colour = "Host phylum") +
  theme_phage_uv() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "#E6E6E6", linewidth = 0.25))
save_candidate("host-phage-link-degree", p_host, 8.2, 7.3)

instrain <- taxonomy[instrain, on = "MAG_ID"]
instrain[, phylum_display := fifelse(
  phylum %chin% names(phage_uv_phylum_colours),
  phylum,
  "Other"
)]
instrain[, comparison_axis := factor(
  comparison_axis,
  levels = c("condition", "cycle", "phase"),
  labels = c("Control versus phage-UV", "Across cycles", "Initial versus backflush")
)]
mag_order <- instrain[, .(max_distance = max(mean_snv_distance, na.rm = TRUE)), by = MAG_ID][
  order(max_distance)
]$MAG_ID
instrain[, MAG_ID := factor(MAG_ID, levels = mag_order)]
axis_colours <- c(
  "Control versus phage-UV" = phage_uv_condition_colours[["treatment"]],
  "Across cycles" = "#4C78A8",
  "Initial versus backflush" = "#8C8C8C"
)

p_snv <- ggplot(
  instrain,
  aes(x = mean_snv_distance, y = MAG_ID, colour = comparison_axis, shape = comparison_axis)
) +
  geom_point(size = 2.1, alpha = 0.88, position = position_jitter(height = 0.08, width = 0)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = axis_colours) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17, 1)) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_number(big.mark = ",")) +
  labs(
    x = "Mean SNV distance (log scale)",
    y = NULL,
    colour = "Comparison",
    shape = "Comparison"
  ) +
  theme_phage_uv() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "#E6E6E6", linewidth = 0.25))
save_candidate("instrain-snv-comparison-context", p_snv, 8.2, 5.8)

uv_by_mag <- unique(uv_summary[, .(
  MAG_ID,
  signature_tier,
  signature_category,
  n_unique_signature_symbols
)])
uv_by_mag <- taxonomy[uv_by_mag, on = "MAG_ID"]
phylum_sizes <- taxonomy[, .(n_phylum_mags = uniqueN(MAG_ID)), by = phylum]
shown_phyla <- phylum_sizes[order(-n_phylum_mags)][seq_len(min(15L, .N))]$phylum
shown_phyla <- unique(c(
  shown_phyla,
  "Eremiobacterota",
  "JACPWU01"
))
uv_shown <- uv_by_mag[phylum %chin% shown_phyla]
uv_prevalence <- uv_shown[, .(
  n_category_mags = uniqueN(MAG_ID),
  median_symbols = as.numeric(median(n_unique_signature_symbols, na.rm = TRUE))
), by = .(phylum, signature_tier, signature_category)]
uv_prevalence <- phylum_sizes[uv_prevalence, on = "phylum"]
uv_prevalence[, prevalence := n_category_mags / n_phylum_mags]
uv_prevalence[, phylum := factor(
  phylum,
  levels = rev(phylum_sizes[phylum %chin% shown_phyla][order(n_phylum_mags)]$phylum)
)]
category_order <- c(
  "nucleotide_excision_repair",
  "photoreactivation",
  "recombination_repair",
  "SOS_response",
  "oxidative_stress",
  "redox_stress",
  "base_excision_oxidative_repair",
  "general_stress"
)
uv_prevalence[, signature_category := factor(signature_category, levels = category_order)]
fwrite(uv_prevalence, file.path(tables_dir, "uv_signature_phylum_prevalence.tsv"), sep = "\t")

p_uv <- ggplot(
  uv_prevalence,
  aes(
    x = signature_category,
    y = phylum,
    size = prevalence,
    fill = signature_category
  )
) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, colour = "#333333", stroke = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = phage_uv_signature_colours, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 8, limits = c(0, 1), labels = percent_format()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, size = "MAG prevalence", fill = "UV-response category") +
  theme_phage_uv() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_line(colour = "#EEEEEE", linewidth = 0.25),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
save_candidate("uv-signature-potential-by-phylum", p_uv, 9.2, 6.2)

manifest <- data.table(
  artifact = c(
    "mag-selection-taxonomic-context",
    "host-phage-link-degree",
    "instrain-snv-comparison-context",
    "uv-signature-potential-by-phylum",
    "uv-transcription-paired-condition",
    "uv-transcription-treatment-effect",
    "sos-transcription-marker-effects",
    "community-rna-dna-temporal-response",
    "sos-mag-continuous-response-heatmap",
    "population-genomics-pairwise-landscape",
    "full-de-condition-landscape",
    "full-de-functional-category-enrichment",
    "full-de-mag-condition-coherence",
    "full-de-recurrent-gene-cell-effects"
  ),
  status = c(
    "candidate_unallocated",
    "deferred",
    "retired_wrong_inference",
    "candidate_unallocated",
    "quarantined_quick_check",
    "quarantined_quick_check",
    "quarantined_quick_check",
    "quarantined_quick_check",
    "quarantined_quick_check",
    "candidate_unallocated",
    "candidate_unallocated",
    "candidate_unallocated",
    "candidate_unallocated",
    "candidate_unallocated"
  ),
  note = c(
    "Taxonomic composition across the analysis selection funnel",
    "Deduplicated host-vOTU degree for the 30 most connected MAGs",
    "SNV-distance context across condition, cycle, and phase comparisons",
    "Prevalence of UV-response potential across recurrent MAG phyla",
    "Preselected UV-response CPM quick check; prohibited from manuscript or supplement",
    "Preselected UV-response effect quick check; prohibited from manuscript or supplement",
    "Preselected SOS-marker quick check; prohibited from manuscript or supplement",
    "Preselected DNA-repair/SOS RNA:DNA quick check; prohibited from manuscript or supplement",
    "Preselected SOS-module MAG quick check; prohibited from manuscript or supplement",
    "Descriptive pairwise population-genomic heterogeneity for coverage-qualified MAGs; no damage or mutagenesis inference",
    "Complete-universe adjusted condition landscape; condition is confounded with membrane identity",
    "Post-model competitive tests for eight frozen functional categories",
    "Post-model organism-resolved directional coherence across 340 eligible MAGs",
    "Descriptive six-cell recurrence for complete-universe tested features"
  )
)
fwrite(manifest, file.path(out_root, "candidate_figure_manifest.tsv"), sep = "\t")

message("Wrote unallocated candidate figures to: ", figures_dir)

```
